**Finding: missing (critical) — no IP/data ownership clause exists.**

What I checked:
- **Section 1 (HDI's Responsibilities)** — HDI designs, develops, hosts and bears all costs for the Site (1.1–1.3), and holds the systems, administration tools and order export files (1.4–1.5). No ownership language.
- **Section 2** — the Company supplies all Content, but "Content" is undefined and unallocated as to ownership.
- **Section 5 (Site; Site Management)** — 5.2 gives us only *artistic and editorial control* and approval rights; 5.3 covers title to physical Deerskin Products, not IP.
- **Section 6.1** — a limited trademark licence of our Marks to HDI (a licence, not ownership; and it expressly negates implied Mark licences).
- **Section 7.1** — reciprocal customer e-mail list cross-promotion, subject to each Party's approval; not an ownership provision.
- **Sections 8, 10.2, 10.3** — confidentiality, no-joint-venture (including a "co-ownership" disclaimer for the *relationship* only), and assignment of the *Agreement*. Searches for "own", "assign" and "intellectual property" turned up nothing on deliverables, work product or data.

No assignment of our IP or data to HDI exists to reverse, so this is not a walk-away deviation — but the silence is material: HDI funds and hosts development, so absent an express allocation our ownership of the Site, our Content and the customer/order/user data is exposed.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new **Section 5.5 (Ownership)** inserted at the end of Section 5, vesting in the Company the Content, the Site and its look and feel, all deliverables and work product, and all customer/order/transaction/user data ("Company Data"), with an HDI assignment; HDI retains its pre-existing software, systems, tools and know-how and grants us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any HDI materials embedded in the Site; no joint ownership, expressly preserving the existing Section 6.1 and 7.1 licences. The comment offers the fallback licence-based construct if HDI resists the assignment.
